description: Open roles at one company: give a company name, website or board URL and get the jobs open now on its public board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, BambooHR, Personio, Teamtailor, Rippling, Gem, Breezy, Pinpoint), with the ATS it uses and its open-role count. Filter by title, location or remote. Returns the newest 50 matching jobs (title, location, remote flag, salary when shown, apply link). Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
